FakeA Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

SPRINGFIELD, October 29, 2026 -- FakeA Inc. (Nasdaq: FAKEA) today reported financial results for its fiscal third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Widget revenue grew 14% year over year to $3.2 billion, driven by the Gizmo line in the U.S. and Canada. "We shipped more Gizmos than in any prior quarter," said J. Doe, chief executive officer of FakeA Inc. Operating margin was 21.4%, up from 21.1% a year ago. The board declared a dividend of $0.25 per share.

Restructuring charges of $45 million related to the closure of the Shelbyville plant were recorded in the quarter. The company expects the program to finish by Dec. 31, 2026.
